Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter

Dear Mr. Shah,

Thank you for meeting us on 28 January 2023 about your dispute with Leena Jadhav. As we understand it, the complaint turns a business disagreement into a criminal case.

Our advice is to argue that the dispute is civil in nature and offer to cooperate with the investigation. Please collect the partnership papers and the correspondence with the complainant and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 70,50,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
